gates.When: After B01 learner evidence is complete
gates.Must prove: Independent transfer across Engineering SQL Transition without solution help, with inspectable validation and recovery evidence.
gates.Pass standard: Every required competency is demonstrated with inspectable evidence; no unresolved critical failure and no percentage shortcut.
gates.Critical fail: Silent data corruption/fan-out, unsafe publish, fabricated evidence, exposed secrets/private data, or inability to reproduce/validate the result.
gates.If failed: Open the protected review only after the saved attempt, repair the exact weak competency, record a changed micro-proof, then explicitly assign a sealed fresh Gate only if required.
gates.Job implication: A pass is course evidence of this bridge competency, not a guarantee of employment.
